+	# conservative streams. Validate every singleton field before returning.
+	if operations.size() == 0
+		return array_loop_proof_result(0)
+	end
+	if operations.size() == 1
+		row := operations[0]
+		if row.size() == 6

+					return array_loop_proof_result(- 1)
+				end
+				mut field := 1
+				while field < 5
+					if row[field] != 0
+						return array_loop_proof_result(- 1)
+					end
+					field += 1
+				end
+				return array_loop_proof_result(0)
+			end
+		end
+	end

 	# current version, zero initializer. Region: identity, index, Array,
 	# guard version, eligible, unit-update count.

diff --git a/compiler/src/mir_loop_bounds_test.trb b/compiler/src/mir_loop_bounds_test.trb

+++ b/compiler/src/mir_loop_bounds_test.trb
@@ -29,6 +29,26 @@ def nested_loop_bounds_operations(): Array<Array<Integer>>
 end
 
 describe("MIR Array loop proof core") do
+	test("validates complete conservative streams before avoiding workspaces") do
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([])).to_equal([0])
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]])).to_equal([0])
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20]])).to_equal([0])
+		mut field := 1
+		while field < 5
+			mut rows := [[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20]]
+			rows[0][field] = 1
+			expect(verify_array_loop_bounds(rows)).to_equal([- 1])
+			rows[0][field] =- 1
+			expect(verify_array_loop_bounds(rows)).to_equal([- 1])
+			field += 1
+		end
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, - 1]])).to_equal([- 1])
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0]])).to_equal([- 1])
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20, 0]])).to_equal([- 1])
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20], [8, 1, 0, 0, 0, 21]])).to_equal([- 1])
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20], [8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 21]])).to_equal([0])
+	end
+
 	test("selects only reads dominated by the same immutable Array and index") do
 		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds(simple_loop_bounds_operations())).to_equal([0, 4])
 		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds(nested_loop_bounds_operations())).to_equal([0, 6, 7])
